dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Do you wanna know the trick to drinking hard liquor, {NICKNAME}? It's all about pacing yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Take a small sip, then give your tastebuds some time to rest. The burning sensation spreads to your lips, then the aftertaste kicks in. Once you can take a breath in without tasting anything, then you can take your next sip.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Stick to that pace, and even Death After Noon loses its power over you. I like to think that the same principle applies in combat.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Launching a direct offensive doesn't sound like the wisest strategy when we're up against powerful beings.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: That said, I'd sure like to spectate and see how things play out... Oh wait, I almost forgot — I'm supposed to be one of the ones doing the fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Heh. Alright, don't worry, {NICKNAME}. I'll start taking this seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: If I know you, you won't stop until you've plumbed the depths of this domain and uncovered every secret it hides.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Don't get me wrong, I have nothing but admiration for the people who see things through to the end, whatever path they're on.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But you never know what price you'll have to pay to reach your destination. The unfortunate reality is, it's up to the whims of fate.
